I think where most companies struggle isn’t understanding what Salesforce is…
but how to actually use it as a system.

Because having:

→ data
→ AI
→ tools

doesn’t automatically create value.

The real challenge is:

→ How do you structure your data so AI can act on it?
→ How do you design processes that connect teams end-to-end?
→ How do you turn insights into decisions?

That’s where most implementations fall short.

Especially now with AI — it’s not just about having the tech,
it’s about how well your system is designed to support it.

Been diving deeper into this recently with others working on Salesforce + AI systems — interesting to see how big the gap still is 👀
